component.title: Sidebar Shell
component.purpose: One sidebar parent for both the desktop resizable panel and the mobile drawer, so an adopting scenario renders its navigation once.

states.description: Persistent desktop panel with the shell-owned resize seam.
The same shell as a modal drawer with backdrop and close control.

claims.statement: Desktop panel and mobile drawer are the same element in the same tree, so navigation content is authored and rendered once.
The sidebar is resizable from the keyboard and the drawer closes on Escape.
Every part's test id derives from one testId prop, so an adopting scenario keeps its selector registry without re-implementing the element.
Callers pass bounds, not geometry: the hit-target width lives in one token read by both the paint and the clamp arithmetic.
